name: title-hard
prompt: Create a standalone polished Chinese game title wordmark on a truly transparent RGBA background. Exact text, exactly FOUR simplified Chinese characters in this order: 困难关卡 . Character-by-character: 困 / 难 / 关 / 卡 . Do not add spaces, punctuation, other words or extra symbols. Reference image is only rough layout and color guidance; redraw as premium rounded fat bold typography with soft corners, balanced readable strokes and uniform baseline, horizontal NOT tilted. All FOUR character faces pure warm WHITE with very subtle soft upper-right light bevel, no colored front fills. Thick unified deep burnt-orange outline #9C2F14 around all strokes and counterforms; below the outline add a second lower extrusion/thickness layer in orange-red #D2452A creating short rounded 3D depth. Characters have roomy readable inner counters, neither fragile thin strokes nor square harsh industrial type. Specifically check 困 is an enclosing box with 木 inside; 难 is 又 plus 隹; 关 is the standard simplified 关; 卡 is the standard 卡. Do not stylize away or merge components. Only the four-character wordmark, no capsule/banner, badge, faces, stars, sparks, effects, background, floor shadow, glow, English or Latin letters. Final output intended for 680 by 180, wide ratio around 3.78:1, large readable glyphs distributed across the width with equal balanced spacing, fully visible outline and bottom thickness without clipping. Render large in a wide transparent canvas with tight even safety margins.
